title: Why 49ers are 'not in rush' to move Brandon Aiyuk, even if WR doesn't play

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Why 49ers are 'not in rush' to move Brandon Aiyuk, even if WR doesn't play
sources.description: The 49ers acknowledge wide receiver Brandon Aiyuk will not not play for them again. But that doesn't mean they are in a rush to move him. Here's why.
